items.title: Global Asset Allocation: House Views August 2026 – Bessent And The Back End

items.title: Asia Insights: Thailand: The high concentration of FDI inflows into data centers
items.quote: Despite the recent surge in FDI approvals, we maintain our 2026-27 GDP growth forecasts at 1.8% and 2.0%, below our estimate of potential growth at around 2.4%.
items.quote_zh: 儘管近期 FDI 核准激增，我們仍維持 2026 至 2027 年 GDP 成長預估為 1.8% 與 2.0%，低於我們估計約 2.4% 的潛在成長率。

items.title: Asia Insights: Thailand: The high concentration of FDI inflows into data centers
items.quote: Data centers will likely deliver limited spillovers to the domestic economy, as they rely heavily on imported equipment, while the boost to construction activity is temporary.
items.quote_zh: 資料中心對國內經濟的外溢效果可能有限，因為它們高度倚賴進口設備，而對營建活動的拉抬只是暫時性的。

items.title: Asia Insights: Thailand: The high concentration of FDI inflows into data centers

items.quote_zh: 隨著中國電動車取代日系燃油車生產，這種組成上的位移對泰國經濟可能產生淨負面影響。

items.title: Oil Analyst: Running Hard or Hardly Running: Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins

items.title: Oil Analyst: Running Hard or Hardly Running: Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins

items.title: Oil Analyst: Running Hard or Hardly Running: Effect of Refinery Outages on Runs and Margins

items.title: India Financials: What Could Drive the Return of Private Banks?

items.title: India Financials: What Could Drive the Return of Private Banks?

items.quote_zh: 我們認為，更大的競爭風險落在企業銀行與商業銀行業務。

items.title: Global Credit Trader: IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: The IG non-financial market has seen over $270 billion of private placement supply year to date, which is the entire supply seen last year, and puts 2026 on track for a new record.
items.quote_zh: IG 非金融市場今年迄今已看到超過 2,700 億美元的私募供給，等於去年一整年的量，讓 2026 年有望創下新紀錄。

items.title: Global Credit Trader: IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche

items.title: Global Credit Trader: IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: We estimate approximately $2.4 trillion of USD IG bonds are currently index-ineligible due to the absence of registration rights, representing 20% of the broader USD IG market.
items.quote_zh: 我們估計目前約有 2.4 兆美元的美元 IG 債因缺少註冊權而不具指數納入資格，占整體美元 IG 市場的 20%。

items.title: Global Credit Trader: IG Private Placements—No Longer Niche
items.quote: Notwithstanding the localized widening of the premium for AI-related issuers, the pickup in trading volumes and compression of the overall private placement premium indicate to us a growing institutional comfort and demand for this asset class.
items.quote_zh: 儘管 AI 相關發行人的溢價出現局部走闊，成交量的回升與整體私募溢價的壓縮，在我們看來顯示機構對這個資產類別的接受度與需求正在提高。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: In response to the oil shock, central banks have pivoted toward somewhat tighter policy. Across our panel of 27 major central banks, our forecast for policy rates has been revised higher for 17, including 175 bp higher in Brazil, 125 bp higher in Indonesia, and 100 bp higher in the UK and South Africa
items.quote_zh: 為因應油價衝擊，各國央行已轉向略為緊縮的政策。在我們追蹤的 27 家主要央行中，有 17 家的政策利率預測被上修，其中巴西上修 175 個基點、印尼 125 個基點、英國與南非各 100 個基點。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: If he fails to tackle these issues head on, he ultimately may be pressed to demonstrate his inflation-fighting commitment by actually hiking rates. Our reading of the macro fundamentals leaves us doubtful that rate hikes are necessary but, at some point, central bankers must act as necessary to defend their credibility.
items.quote_zh: 若他（Warsh）不正面處理這些問題，最終可能被迫以實際升息來證明自己打擊通膨的決心。我們對總體基本面的解讀讓我們懷疑升息並無必要，但在某個時點，央行官員終究必須為捍衛信譽而採取必要行動。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: We now see a rate hike in September and three more hikes next year that together will bring Japan’s policy rate to 2%, which is plausibly in the neighborhood of neutral
items.quote_zh: 我們現在預期九月升息一次、明年再升三次，合計將把日本政策利率帶到 2%，這大致可視為落在中性利率附近。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain
items.quote: prolonged back-and-forth in this process led us to mark-to-market for 3Q’26 to $80/bbl Brent average, with 4Q’26 remaining at $70 and 2027 at $65 Brent average.
items.quote_zh: 這個過程長期來回拉鋸，使我們把 2026 年第三季布蘭特均價按市價調整到每桶 80 美元，第四季維持 70 美元、2027 年維持 65 美元。

items.title: Global Economic Outlook & Strategy: Global Resilience—Many Storm Clouds, but Still Little Rain

items.title: Global Tech Optical Networking The next mega trend in AI infrastructure
items.quote: CPO appears costly considering 3D packaging, high integration, and the need to upgrade devices to semiconductor processing levels; however, the total cost of ownership (TCO) is attractive especially in high bandwidth requirement (e.g. 6.4T, 12.8T)
items.quote_zh: 考量 3D 封裝、高整合度、以及元件必須升級到半導體製程等級，CPO 看起來成本高昂；然而在高頻寬需求（例如 6.4T、12.8T）下，總持有成本是有吸引力的。
items.verdict: 主張本身沒有可裁決的門檻。原句說 CPO 成本高昂但在高頻寬需求下總持有成本有吸引力，但沒有給出 TCO 的對照基準、沒有給出時點、也沒有說「有吸引力」要用什麼數字認定，任何後續結果都可以事後套上。到期日 2026-07-16 已過兩個月，不是證據還沒到，是這條主張沒有可證偽的形狀，因此結案而非延後。

items.title: Global Tech Optical Networking The next mega trend in AI infrastructure
items.quote: we expect (1) pluggable optical module would co-exist with NPO / CPO, and on continuous speed migration toward 3.2T
items.quote_zh: 我們預期（1）可插拔光模組將與 NPO／CPO 共存，並持續朝 3.2T 升速。
items.verdict: 這一筆有可觀察的門檻（可插拔模組與 NPO／CPO 是否共存、是否朝 3.2T 升速），但本系統結構上取不到資料：本期五庫涵蓋 40 集節目、35 張圖、22 項監控指標、12 份券商報告，沒有任何一處落到光模組出貨量或速率規格這一層，前六期亦無。不寫延後的理由是這個缺口不是時間造成的——匯流的五個資料源不涵蓋單一元件的產業供應鏈資料，等下一期也不會有。

items.title: Global Tech Optical Networking The next mega trend in AI infrastructure
items.quote: While the networking technology migration is a certain trend, the pace of adoption varies
items.quote_zh: 網路技術移轉雖是確定的趨勢，採用的速度卻各有不同。
items.verdict: 主張自帶雙向出口：「技術移轉是確定的趨勢，採用的速度卻各有不同」——採用快、採用慢、各家不一致，三種觀測都與它相容，沒有任何結果會與它矛盾。無法證偽的陳述不是還沒到可以判的時候，是永遠判不了，因此結案為無法驗證而不是延後。
